# XLS fixtures

- `sheets.xls` was generated with xls-writer. It contains three worksheets:
  `Cities` (Unicode, quotes, delimiters, an embedded newline, and an empty row),
  `Notes` (comma-containing text and literal `=1+1`), and `Empty`.
- `mixed-xlwt.xls` is copied from xls-reader's testdata. It was generated by the
  independent Python xlwt writer and includes numeric, boolean, date, rich-text,
  and formula cells. Expected converted values are checked in converter_test.go.

These are synthetic test data; no external tools are needed to run the tests.

- `headers.xls` was generated with xls-writer. It contains empty sheets, repeated
  headers, a header-like data row, different letter case and column counts, a
  header-only sheet, and a sheet with a leading blank row. It tests concatenation
  and exact first-row matching without removing data rows.
